policy: Dated aggregate asking-price observations for buyer planning. These are not completed sales, dealer quotes, or a live marketplace feed. No listing photos or seller content are reproduced.

observations.method: First 20 visible results reviewed; retained ten Local Used 2005 offers. Excluded Foreign Used, one described as a 2004 car, and one ambiguous upgraded car. Interpolated quartiles of the ten asking prices, rounded to the nearest NGN 100,000.
observations.limitations: The marketplace page was last crawled about six days before this review, so availability was not verified today. Repeated sellers, mileage, mechanical condition, and modifications may shift this small sample. This is a local buying band, not a new-import quote; the official trade portal's less-than-15-year import rule makes a 2005 model outside its stated age limit in 2026. Inspect the car and documents before paying.

observations.method: First 20 visible results reviewed; 19 marked Foreign Used. Values are the lower quartile, median, and upper quartile of those asking prices, rounded to the nearest NGN 100,000.
observations.limitations: Promoted placements, duplicate ads, trim, mileage, condition, and seller claims may skew this small sample. Prices and availability can change. Inspect the car and verify customs documents before paying.

corroboratingSources.method: Nine visible 2018 Corolla listings marked foreign used; excluded 2008 vehicles returned by this search page. Median of asking prices, not completed sales.

observations.method: First 20 visible results reviewed; excluded one listing labelled 2012 whose description said 2014. Interpolated 25th, 50th, and 75th percentiles of 19 Foreign Used asking prices, rounded to the nearest NGN 100,000.
observations.limitations: A recent search snapshot, not a live feed. Promoted placement, repeat sellers, trim, mileage, and condition affect the sample. Confirm listing availability and inspect the vehicle before paying.

observations.method: First 20 visible results reviewed; excluded local-used, brand-new, and a contradictory registered/foreign-used listing. Interpolated 25th, 50th, and 75th percentiles of 15 Foreign Used asking prices, rounded to the nearest NGN 100,000.
observations.limitations: A recent search snapshot, not a live feed. Petrol, diesel, trim, mileage, promoted placement, and duplicate sellers can shift these figures. Check the exact vehicle and customs papers before paying.

observations.method: First 20 visible results reviewed; excluded one Local Used listing. Interpolated 25th, 50th, and 75th percentiles of 19 Foreign Used asking prices, rounded to the nearest NGN 100,000.
observations.limitations: A dated search snapshot, not a live feed. Sport, SE, ECO, Limited, mileage, promoted placement, and repeat sellers may skew this model-year sample. Verify the exact trim, condition, and documents before paying.

observations.method: First 20 visible results reviewed; excluded three Local Used listings and one listing whose description quoted a different price from the displayed ask. Interpolated 25th, 50th, and 75th percentiles of 16 Foreign Used asking prices, rounded to the nearest NGN 100,000.
observations.limitations: A dated search snapshot, not a live feed. EX, SE, Touring, drivetrain, mileage, promoted placement, and repeat sellers may shift this broad model-year band. Inspect the exact car and customs documents.

observations.method: First 20 visible results reviewed; excluded one Local Used listing. Interpolated 25th, 50th, and 75th percentiles of 19 Foreign Used asking prices, rounded to the nearest NGN 100,000.
observations.limitations: A dated search snapshot, not a live feed. Several first-page asks are from Apapa sellers; repeated offers, V6 versus four-cylinder trims, mileage, and promoted placement may skew the band. Verify the exact car and seller before paying.

observations.method: First 20 visible results reviewed; excluded six Local Used offers, one labelled 2017 but described as 2018, and one foreign-used offer advertised as a 2020 body upgrade. Interpolated quartiles of 12 Foreign Used 2017 E300 asking prices, rounded to the nearest NGN 100,000.
observations.limitations: This sample covers E300 petrol offers, not an E200 or diesel E-Class price. 4Matic, AMG styling, mileage, promoted placement, and seller claims may affect the broad band. Confirm the exact trim and documents before comparing with a source-market quote.

observations.method: First 20 visible results reviewed; excluded two Local Used offers, one described as registered despite its Foreign Used label, and one with an ambiguous 2017/2018 year. Interpolated quartiles of 16 Foreign Used RX350 asking prices, rounded to the nearest NGN 100,000.
observations.limitations: RX350 standard, AWD, and F Sport trims are mixed. This sample does not establish an RX450h hybrid price. Promoted placement, repeat sellers, mileage, and condition can shift the band; verify the exact car before comparing with an import quote.

observations.method: First 20 visible results reviewed; all were labelled Foreign Used and described as 2016 ES350. Interpolated quartiles of the asking prices, rounded to the nearest NGN 100,000. An Autochek Lagos sample is reported separately.
observations.limitations: Several Jiji offers have very similar seller copy, so one dealer may be overrepresented. Trim options, mileage, promoted placement, and unverified seller claims can shift the band. These are asks, not completed sales.

corroboratingSources.sourceName: Autochek Nigeria 2016 Lexus ES results (Lagos subset)
corroboratingSources.method: Five 2016 Lexus ES listings explicitly located in Lagos and labelled foreign used; excluded Abuja, local-used, and location-unknown offers. Median asking price. Mileage claims are unverified.
